latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of board-meeting-prep-coach

- Guides CEOs, CFOs, COOs, and chiefs-of-staff through every aspect of preparing for and running a board meeting, from early-stage to Series-D.
- Covers board meeting objectives, effective pre-meeting work (including pre-read timing and content), board deck structure, and run-of-show.
- Provides frameworks for handling difficult conversations (missed quarters, exec changes, fundraising, M&A, founder-board friction) and executive sessions.
- Details best practices for board materials, pre-meeting 1:1s, meeting pacing, and post-meeting follow-up.
- Lists common mistakes and how to avoid them.
- Triggered by phrases related to board meetings, board prep, executive sessions, and related topics.
